title.zh: US Senator Blumenthal Calls Tether's USDT a 'Superhighway' for Iranian Sanctions Evasion
title.en: US Senator Blumenthal Calls Tether's USDT a 'Superhighway' for Iranian Sanctions Evasion

current_state.zh: Democratic staff on the Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations released a report finding that 84% of 846 crypto wallets sanctioned over links to Iran and its proxies transacted exclusively or nearly exclusively in Tether's USDT, prompting Tether to cite $550 million in Iran-related freezes this year.
